text: CRITICAL: Floodwaters rising rapidly in Riverside Sector 4, elderly residents trapped on roofs, need urgent boat rescue teams!
Over 2,500 people displaced and sheltering in primary school gymnasiums following embankment breach.
Highway 104 bridge collapsed near river crossing; main electrical grid substation is completely submerged and offline.
Meteorological department issues severe red alert forecast for coastal district over next 24 hours.
Enjoying the rain with a cup of warm coffee at home, hope everyone stays cozy this weekend!
